caption: Five hundred devices publish 200-byte messages every 10 minutes — 72,000 messages and 14.4 MB per day — over MQTT/TLS to the platform's secure endpoint. The platform keeps the last reported state in a shadow, and the rules engine forwards only readings below the moisture limit to storage, which feeds the dashboard; no device talks to the database directly.

spec.title: IoT platform pipeline
spec.aria: Five hundred soil-moisture devices publish 200-byte messages every 10 minutes over MQTT/TLS to AWS IoT Core or Azure IoT Hub, which stores the last reported state in a shadow and routes only readings below the moisture limit through the rules engine to storage and a dashboard.
